info.name: Email on Acid Authentication Email Testing API

description.content:
REST API for automating email testing across 100+ email clients and devices, including email rendering previews, spam filter testing, seed list management, and accessibility checks. Now branded as Mailgun Inspect. Supports sandbox mode for development and test result storage for 90 days.
